purpose: Known live article-to-tool integration defects (Master Roadmap 6.3). Each gate is an open CMS content-correction release gate, not an exemption: the preflight fails for any unlisted defect, and for any listed gate that no longer matches the live record (fixed, changed or unpublished). Remove a gate only when the corrected article is published. Gates describe production records and apply only to an inventory from cmsOrigin; other inventories (fixtures, synthetic CMS) get the generic rule with no gates.
